🥚 Our First Egg! | Mini Homestead Series | Copperas Cove, TX #chickenfarming 

It finally happened — one of Kati’s 22-week-old hens just laid her very first egg! 🐓✨

From raising chicks to caring for a growing flock, this milestone marks a big step in her homesteading journey.

If you’ve ever dreamed of owning a home with space for a garden, chickens, or even a few fruit trees, this is your sign! 🏡 Whether you’re starting small or going full homestead, Kati knows what to look for when finding the perfect property for your lifestyle.
